title: “E la vita, la vita” by Cochi e Renato
text: Cochi e Renato are an Italian musical and comedy duo composed of comedians Renato Pozzetto and Cochi Ponzoni.
listen: E la vita, la vita Cochi e Renato

title: “Un corpo e un'anima” by Wess & Dori Ghezzi
text: "Un corpo e un'anima" is a 1974 song recorded by Wess and Dori Ghezzi.
listen: Un corpo e un'anima Wess & Dori Ghezzi

title: “Un'altra donna” by I cugini di campagna
text: I Cugini di Campagna is an Italian pop band formed in 1970 in Rome. They are well known for their use of falsetto, as well as for their eccentric look (a cross between glam and kitsch).
listen: Un'altra donna I cugini di campagna

title: “You're the First, the Last, My Everything” by Barry White
text: "You're the First, the Last, My Everything" is a song recorded by the American singer and songwriter Barry White from his third album, Can't Get Enough. The song was written by White, Tony Sepe and Peter Radcliffe and produced by White.
wiki: You're the First, the Last, My Everything
listen: You're the First, the Last, My Everything Barry White

title: “Piange... il telefono” by Domenico Modugno
text: "Piange... il telefono" is a song performed by Italian singer and songwriter Domenico Modugno with little Francesca Guadagno.

title: “Parlami d'amore Mariù” by Mal
text: "Parlami d'amore Mariù", known in its English-language versions as "Tell Me That You Love Me", is a 1932 Italian song composed by Cesare Andrea Bixio (music) and Ennio Neri (lyrics).

title: “Tornerò” by I Santo California
text: "Tornerò" is a song by the Italian musical group I Santo California, released in 1974 as their debut single. The following year, the down-tempo love ballad became a number-one hit in Italy as well as a top five hit in German speaking countries.

title: “Amore grande amore libero” by Il Guardiano del Faro
text: Federico Monti Arduini, best known as Il Guardiano del Faro, is an Italian composer, producer and musician. Born in Milan, Arduini was a child prodigy, who started studying piano at very young age and who made his first concerts aged eight years old.
listen: Amore grande amore libero Il Guardiano del Faro

title: “Buonasera dottore” by Claudia Mori
text: Claudia Mori is an Italian producer, retired actress and singer.

title: “Sabato pomeriggio” by Claudio Baglioni
text: Claudio Baglioni is an Italian pop singer-songwriter and musician. His career has been going on for over 50 years.

title: “Profondo rosso” by Goblin
text: Goblin is an Italian progressive rock band known for their film scores. They frequently collaborate with Dario Argento, most notably creating the scores for Profondo Rosso in 1975 and Suspiria in 1977.

title: Apollo–Soyuz Test Project: An American Apollo and a Soviet Soyuz spacecraft dock with each other in orbit marking the first such link-up between spacecraft from the two nations.
text: Apollo–Soyuz was the first crewed international space mission, conducted jointly by the United States and the Soviet Union in July 1975. Millions watched on television as an American Apollo spacecraft docked with a Soviet Soyuz capsule.

title: Viking program: NASA launches the Viking 1 planetary probe toward Mars.
text: The Viking program consisted of a pair of identical American space probes, Viking 1 and Viking 2 both launched in 1975, and landed on Mars in 1976. The mission effort began in 1968 and was managed by the NASA Langley Research Center.

title: Rembrandt's painting The Night Watch is slashed a dozen times at the Rijksmuseum in Amsterdam.
text: Rembrandt Harmenszoon van Rijn, known mononymously as Rembrandt, was a Dutch Golden Age painter, printmaker, and draughtsman. He is generally considered one of the greatest visual artists in the history of Western art.

title: The artists' community Kollektiv Herzogstrasse is founded by Heimrad Prem and others.
text: Heimrad Prem was a German painter born in Roding, Oberpfalz. From 1949 to 1952 he studied decorative painting at Schwandorf and then studied painting with Josef Oberberger and sculpture with Toni Stadler at the Akademie der Bildenden Künste, Munich until 1956.

title: The Brotherhood of Ruralists is established at Wellow, Somerset, England.
text: The Brotherhood of Ruralists is a British art group founded in 1975 in Wellow, Somerset, to paint nature. Their work is figurative with a strong adherence to 'traditional' skills.

title: Mona Hatoum leaves her native Lebanon to study at the Byam Shaw School of Art in London.
text: Mona Hatoum is a British-Palestinian multimedia and installation artist who lives in London.

title: Four Ronnie Landfield paintings from the collection of Philip Johnson are installed at The Four Seasons Restaurant in New York City, on the wall which Mark Rothko was initially commissioned to create paintings for, and subsequently changed…
text: Ronnie Landfield is an American abstract painter. During his early career from the mid-1960s through the 1970s his paintings were associated with Lyrical Abstraction (related to Postminimalism, Color Field painting, and Abstract expressionism), and he was represented by the David Whitney Gallery and the André Emmerich Gallery.
